original_decision: Create a new `sophia-next` monorepo. Keep existing Sophia as a donor and live legacy product.
rationale: No in-place completion of the old middleware/Builder control architecture. No destructive migration in the bootstrap.
current_disposition: Achieved in davidelaverga/Sophia; do not create sophia-next again.

original_decision: Node 24 and pnpm 11.7.0; ESM TypeScript for the new application. Pin dsh source to `46a7f68…`, version `0.1.7-rc.1`.
rationale: Matches the inspected upstream toolchain. The exact Node patch and OCI digest are frozen during S1-01; they are not fabricated here.
current_disposition: Runtime pin superseded by merged M02 dsh0.2.0-rc.2 at 639ed015397290b3745d163aafe02ffee4aa3f84; exact Node24.21.0 and pnpm11.7.0 retained.

original_decision: Start the official `dsh` CLI with `sophia-runtime`, stacking dsh-base and our bundle.
rationale: Use the supported launcher and actual plugin boundaries; no custom root agent loop. [DSH-01–DSH-05]
current_disposition: Retained constraint; use current source and v2.0 implementation location.

original_decision: Use a Sophia Cordis control plugin over the public Agent API, not the stock SDK as our complete control transport.
rationale: Stock SDK cannot express our mid-turn Stop. The new bridge maps typed commands to actual lifecycle operations. [DSH-06–DSH-10]
current_disposition: Retained constraint; use current source and v2.0 implementation location.

original_decision: One project-scoped dsh runtime container/home at a time; separate per-task build containers.
rationale: Project recovery and model history remain isolated. A room visit does not own project lifetime. Raw user build scripts never run inside the API or media service.
current_disposition: Retained constraint; use current source and v2.0 implementation location.

original_decision: Fastify API, Supabase Auth/Postgres/Storage, SQL jobs/outbox and replayable SSE. No Redis or second workflow engine in S1.
rationale: One small application authority; no writable Git plan mirror competing with accepted database state.
current_disposition: Existing admission/outbox retained. Paperclip is now the selected operational service for new managed work, not a second scheduler for old attempts.

original_decision: Custom React/Vite Studio; retain the actual V2-R1 visual/semantic reference.
rationale: Do not expose the dsh web UI or Omnigent dashboard as Sophia's product. Lenses remain local views over common records.
current_disposition: Current merged Luis Chat/Brief side panel supersedes earlier visual placement; custom React/Vite product retained.

original_decision: LiveKit Cloud for the room; raw `@livekit/rtc-node` in a Sophia media bridge. Do not install LiveKit AgentSession as another reasoning runtime.
rationale: Keep transport, speaker identity and media lifecycle while owning the Gemini connection and tool rules. [LK-01–LK-04]
current_disposition: Retained constraint; use current source and v2.0 implementation location.

original_decision: Google Gemini API (not Vertex for this first route), `gemini-3.8-live`, `@google/genai` 2.24.0.
rationale: Explicit latest user decision. The inspected FunctionResponse generator property is not supported in Vertex; the chosen API avoids pretending parity. [GG-01, G-06]
current_disposition: Retained constraint; use current source and v2.0 implementation location.

original_decision: Live is the conversational voice model; dsh guide is the text route; both use the same context compiler and action API.
rationale: No compulsory dsh call for every spoken sentence. Long reasoning and engineering go to dsh/engineers; one visible Sophia, not two simultaneous narrators.
current_disposition: Current voice and typed room conversation both use Gemini Live; future private Companion is a separate explicit decision.

original_decision: S1 voice uses an explicit admitted-input floor and open exchange. S2 adds consented per-participant discussion following.
rationale: Reliable attribution comes from authenticated tracks, not guessing a voiceprint or trusting a name spoken by a model.
current_disposition: Retained constraint; use current source and v2.0 implementation location.

original_decision: Selected visual frames through Live; exact text through scoped artifact/source tools. No whole-desktop control for coordination.
rationale: Observation, precision, edit authority and execution are separate.
current_disposition: Retained constraint; use current source and v2.0 implementation location.

original_decision: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash via `deepseek-flash` is the native research/prototype/lead baseline. Low effort for routine work; high for lead alignment and difficult work.
rationale: Preserves the user's workhorse direction. Alias identity is recorded, not described as an immutable model snapshot. [DSH-14, DS-01]
current_disposition: Historical workhorse preference. Current base route is recorded luna/high; active M03 candidate Sol/medium. No automatic model switch.

original_decision: Google Flash Image default; OpenAI Sunburst first comparison; Google Pro and OpenAI Flare available in the experiment catalog.
rationale: Two actual adapters, immutable assets, explicit comparison choice; no automatic all-model fan-out.
current_disposition: Retained constraint; use current source and v2.0 implementation location.

original_decision: Google image jobs use Interactions with `store:false`; OpenAI uses the direct Images API.
rationale: Avoid unnecessary hosted conversation state and a second text model merely to request an image. [G-07, G-08, OA-03]
current_disposition: Retained constraint; use current source and v2.0 implementation location.

original_decision: Omnigent is a pinned native engineer bridge; owner-started/adopted sessions on the two Macs in S1.
rationale: All three resources are included, without granting the central service arbitrary cross-owner host launch. [OM-01]
current_disposition: Retained constraint; use current source and v2.0 implementation location.

original_decision: Peer messages use a Sophia durable mailbox and narrow MCP-facing tools; adapters wake/deliver through supported native mechanisms. Native dsh teams use their own mailbox.
rationale: No screenshot loop, no permanent coordinator polling, no required lead-model relay. A2A federation is an extension, not a prerequisite.
current_disposition: Retained constraint; use current source and v2.0 implementation location.

original_decision: Five-minute coalesced semantic review while relevant work is active, plus events and manual review.
rationale: Initial real supervision now; timers do not invent evidence or permission requests. One continuation owner per route.
current_disposition: Retained constraint; use current source and v2.0 implementation location.

original_decision: S1 co-review creates a source-bound change/preserve amendment. Exact component-edit enforcement is S2.
rationale: Makes early review valuable without misrepresenting instruction-based preservation as surgical enforcement.
current_disposition: Retained constraint; use current source and v2.0 implementation location.

original_decision: Native prototype source is React/TypeScript/Vite; reuse compatible components/assets during handoff.
rationale: Luis works in Preview/Source/Diff. Target repository mismatch is an explicit integration issue, not silent screenshot recreation.
current_disposition: Retained constraint; use current source and v2.0 implementation location.

original_decision: Render hosts public API and Omnigent. One private Docker execution VM hosts the runtime supervisor, media bridge and isolated jobs. Vercel hosts the static Studio.
rationale: Long-lived media and isolation have a concrete home. The added VM is an explicit operating cost; no unsupported Docker-in-Render assumption.
current_disposition: Topology is subject to actual release records and qualified isolated hosts; no automatic migration to an illustrative VM arrangement.

original_decision: Accepted state in Postgres; source objects and scoped Markdown knowledge; direct lookup plus Postgres text search first.
rationale: Mem0 is not the source of current project authority; no initial provider/vector migration is required. Personal memory import is separate.
current_disposition: Retained constraint; use current source and v2.0 implementation location.

original_decision: Selective ChatGPT/Claude import and chosen local repository/session bindings in S1; explicit send-to-Sophia tool trial.
rationale: No undocumented reverse Projects API or whole-account scrape.
current_disposition: Extend selected import with owner-private Bot jobs and explicit package sharing; no whole-account scrape.

original_decision: Learning begins with one accepted lesson used in the next relevant brief.
rationale: Procedure candidates are compared and promoted later. Forecast scoring is optional; no-change is legitimate.
current_disposition: Retained constraint; use current source and v2.0 implementation location.

original_decision: Notion/Supabase/Vercel management connectors are S2 additions; existing native engineer tools deploy in S1.
rationale: Product persistence is not postponed. Shared deployment ownership is still required even when credentials already exist.
current_disposition: Retained constraint; use current source and v2.0 implementation location.

original_decision: One owner-approved Omnigent device grant per founder; normal engineer accounts, separate operator admin.
rationale: The native host/session owner checks remain intact. A single machine subject is not both founders. [OM-01, OM-09, OM-10, OM-11]
current_disposition: Retained constraint; use current source and v2.0 implementation location.

original_decision: Create a dormant session-scoped bundle, install assignment MCP, PATCH selected model/effort, then launch on the owner host and observe before prompting.
rationale: The native Claude adapter ignores per-turn tool/system-prompt injection. Exact multipart and JSON shapes differ. [OM-03, OM-04, OM-07, OM-12]
current_disposition: Retained constraint; use current source and v2.0 implementation location.

original_decision: S1 external Hold is controlled native Stop plus retained project/source handoff; Resume creates a fresh configured native attempt.
rationale: Upstream Stop is non-sticky and its receipt is not settlement. Drain/fence/reconcile prevents late messages reviving work. [OM-05]
current_disposition: Retained constraint; use current source and v2.0 implementation location.

original_decision: Native ambiguous writes become outcome_unknown, not automatic retries. Rotating-refresh uncertainty requires reconnection.
rationale: Native message correlation is not end-to-end deduplication; refresh reuse may revoke the grant. [OM-03, OM-09]
current_disposition: Retained constraint; use current source and v2.0 implementation location.

original_decision: Private Postgres schema, non-admin API/worker roles, normalized command equality, target outbox records and decimal-string event cursors.

current_disposition: Retained constraint; use current source and v2.0 implementation location.

original_decision: Actual Studio reference → production component/API map; one TanStack Query cache and a lazy CodeMirror source editor.

current_disposition: Retained constraint; use current source and v2.0 implementation location.
